changed_source_function: binary_info only; no top-level imports or guards changed

builtin_requires: has_location false and module.__file__ absent or None
dynamic_requires: has_location true and not in builtin module names
origin/module.__file__/loader.path resolve to same regular image
descriptor_contract.dynamic_result: real resolved extension path and file SHA256
descriptor_contract.images: actual regular resolved Python executable plus every libpython/libsqlite3 image path named in this interpreter's own maps; missing/unreadable/nonregular named images failclosed
descriptor_contract.run_binding: unchanged native_run requires full binary_info dictionary == approved preflight binary dictionary, including new descriptor and all loaded image entries

interpretation_boundary: File-byte and descriptor consistency for these declared executable/extension/loaded images, not full-system attestation, not mapped-memory verification, not all dependency attestation. Built-in code may live in the executable or libpython; no fictitious extension path or hash is manufactured. Empty loaded-libsqlite/libpython maps mean none were observed, not a known nonexistent library version.

budgets.actual_cpu_id: record actual ID; no assumed CPUindex1

required_before_any_new_invocation: rebind candidate69+manifest to physical regular canonical len/SHA/Git bytes without overwriting WIP
preserve prior raw and failed partial root
required_first_raw: full preflight.json bytes and SHA if created
actual affinity/resources/binary metadata if persisted; unavailable remains null
